scripts.dev: npm run build -w @gitarena/shared && bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; npm run dev -w @gitarena/api & API_PID=$!; cleanup(){ kill "$API_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM; npm run dev -w @gitarena/web'
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @gitarena/shared && npm run dev -w @gitarena/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @gitarena/shared && npm run dev -w @gitarena/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @gitarena/shared && npm run build -w @gitarena/api && npm run build -w @gitarena/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @gitarena/shared && npm run typecheck -w @gitarena/api && npm run typecheck -w @gitarena/web
